title: San Pedro de Tunasan
description: The city's old name joins its patron, Saint Peter, with Tunasan, 'the place of tunas', a medicinal water plant once abundant on the shore of Laguna de Bay.

title: Sampaguita Capital
description: In the postwar years San Pedro became the country's leading producer of sampaguita buds. The city celebrates this heritage each year with the Sampaguita Festival.

title: Where Tenancy Law Was Signed
description: President Magsaysay signed the Agricultural Tenancy Act (Republic Act No. 1199) at the San Pedro town plaza in 1954, the day the hacienda was sold to the government.

title: Gateway of Laguna
description: San Pedro is the first city of Laguna south of Metro Manila. It has 27 barangays and 348,968 residents as of the 2024 census.
